dialogues.speaker: Xiuhua
dialogues.text: Greetings, are you here to take a meal, or to find a room for the night?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Xiuhua
dialogues.text: I'm Xiuhua, one of the service staff here at the Baiju Guesthouse.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's your story?

dialogues.speaker: Xiuhua
dialogues.text: I'm just one of the serving staff. Nothing special.

dialogues.speaker: Xiuhua
dialogues.text: Except, sometimes I switch places with my twin sister... Please don't be unsettled when that happens!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Xiuhua
dialogues.text: You are always welcome at the Baiju Guesthouse. Come by any time!

dialogues.speaker: Xiuhua
dialogues.text: Greetings, are you here to take a meal, or to find a room for the night?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are...?

dialogues.speaker: Xiuhua
dialogues.text: I'm Yu— Xiuhua! One of the waiting staff here at the Baiju Guesthouse. If there's anything you need, please don't hesitate to ask me!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you really?

dialogues.speaker: Xiuhua
dialogues.text: ...Wha— Why would you say that!? I mean... how did you notice...

dialogues.speaker: Xiuhua
dialogues.text: Hehehe, I'm actually Xiuhua's twin sister, Yuhua. When life is dull and boring, you've got to take the opportunities that being a twin gives you to spice things up a bit...

dialogues.speaker: Xiuhua
dialogues.text: Also... Please keep all this to yourself! Pretty please!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Xiuhua
dialogues.text: You are always welcome at the Wangshu— I mean, the Baiju Guesthouse. Come by any time!

dialogues.speaker: Xiuhua
dialogues.text: I'm surprised the Wangshu Inn doesn't get the day off... It's the biggest day of the year...

dialogues.speaker: Xiuhua
dialogues.text: My sister works there. It's been years since we last spent Lantern Rite together.

dialogues.speaker: Xiuhua
dialogues.text: I should raise it with the Ministry of Civil Affairs...
